name: CPP Investments
coverage: Selected Canada Pension Plan Investment Board relationships in Indian logistics, toll roads, office property and data centres. Direct company equity and platform interests are separate records.
limitations: Selective public-disclosure coverage, not a complete portfolio or a live ownership register. The review date does not update the date of an older holding disclosure.
Ownership belongs to the named entity, fund, subsidiary or platform. Fund commitments, acquisitions of assets and joint-venture stakes are not holdings in the listed parent.
Announced investments remain proposed unless closing evidence was reviewed. An unavailable percentage is not zero.
Investment themes and business cases are research interpretations of the cited activity, not forecasts or recommendations.

ctrls.title: CtrlS announces CPP Investments strategic partnership
ctrls.note: Announced investment and separate development JV; closing not independently confirmed.

indospace.title: CPP Investments and IndoSpace expand joint venture

nhit.title: Third follow-on investment in National Highways Infra Trust

rmz.title: Real-estate holdings as at March 31, 2025
rmz.note: Property-venture ownership interest, not ownership of RMZ Corporation.

companies.name: CtrlS Datacenters
companies.ownership: 8.2% direct stake announced; closing not verified
companies.summary: Separate from the proposed campus-development joint venture.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: growth capital can help expand operating data-centre capacity.
companies.risks: Closing, valuation, construction, power and customer concentration.

companies.name: CtrlS / CPP hyperscale-campus joint venture
companies.ownership: 48% planned JV ownership; distinct from 8.2% in CtrlS
companies.summary: Development funding rather than an additional stake in CtrlS.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: development partnerships can expand capacity while sharing project execution.
companies.risks: Closing, capital commitments, development and power availability.

companies.name: IndoSpace Core
companies.relationship: CPP Investments disclosed 93% ownership of IndoSpace Core when it expanded the JV.
companies.summary: The JV acquired six logistics parks. This percentage is not ownership of IndoSpace’s wider group.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: logistics assets offer exposure to distribution and manufacturing infrastructure.
companies.risks: Leasing, financing, concentration and property valuations.

companies.name: National Highways Infra Trust
companies.relationship: CPP Investments disclosed continued ownership of 25% of NHIT units after a follow-on placement.
companies.ownershipDate: 26 Mar 2025 disclosure; current unit percentage not refreshed
companies.summary: The percentage belongs to trust units, not shares in NHAI or the underlying concession companies.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: established toll roads may offer long-duration infrastructure cash flows.
companies.risks: Traffic, regulation, concession terms and leverage.

companies.name: RMZ India Office Venture – RCIPL
companies.relationship: CPP’s March 2025 holdings list reports an ownership interest in this Hyderabad office venture.
companies.ownership: 50% interest in the named property venture
companies.summary: The property-specific ownership is distinct from CPP owning half of the wider RMZ group.
companies.thesis: Research interpretation: office ventures link returns to leasing and asset management.
companies.risks: Occupancy, development, financing and snapshot age.

events.title: IndoSpace Core acquires six logistics parks
events.detail: CPP Investments announced acquisition of six parks through its JV and a ₹14 billion funding commitment.
events.qualification: The 93% figure describes CPP’s IndoSpace Core ownership, not every IndoSpace fund or operating company.

events.title: Direct CtrlS equity investment announced
events.detail: The company announced a direct-equity investment.

events.title: Separate hyperscale-campus JV announced
events.detail: A separate campus-development venture was announced.
events.qualification: The JV percentage is not combined with the parent-company stake.

report.title: CPP Investments in India
report.summary: CPP Investments’ five reviewed company/platform records include established real-asset interests and proposed data-centre investments. Public disclosure dates and the level of ownership remain visible for each.

sections.title: Pension-investor approach
sections.text: CPP Investments discloses holdings across public equity, private equity, property and infrastructure. Reports have their own valuation dates and do not constitute a live register.

sections.title: Property and roads
sections.text: The IndoSpace, NHIT and RCIPL percentages each describe a particular JV, trust or property venture. They are not holdings in the wider sponsor groups.

sections.title: Digital infrastructure
sections.text: CtrlS announced both a direct equity transaction and a separate campus JV. The two ownership bases remain separate and closing is unverified.

themes.name: Industrial property and roads
themes.case: Research interpretation: logistics parks and toll-road trusts are consistent with long-duration real-asset investing.
themes.watch: Cash flows, concession terms, financing and concentration.

themes.name: Data-centre development
themes.case: Research interpretation: the announced partnership increases potential exposure to digital-infrastructure development.
themes.watch: Closing evidence, deployment and power constraints.
